votes.reason: The source says "If every cheap model fails the same two ambiguous cases", which describes a pattern across models. The target says "Si el modelo barato falla siempre", which is one model failing repeatedly. The escalation argument depends on the failure being shared across models. I uphold it at 3 rather than 4: the recommendation survives, but the reason behind it is weaker. The fix is «Si todos los modelos baratos fallan en los mismos dos casos ambiguos».

The target renders "Evals reward boring seams" as "Los evals premian las uniones aburridas". "Uniones" doesn't suggest the testability sense of a seam, the isolated decision point that the next paragraph describes ("Con la decisión explícita, puedes probar la ruta..."). The joke becomes hard to read at an explanatory transition. Any wording that names separation points or boundaries would fix it.

"«Otros» es donde vive la cicatriz de producción" follows the English "scar tissue lives" word for word. The singular "cicatriz" with "vive" sounds translated. The meaning still gets through, so this is polish. «En "Otros" se acumulan las cicatrices de producción» sounds natural and keeps the dry tone.

The target renders "keep the right evidence" as "conservó las pruebas correctas". In an article about testing, readers will take "pruebas" as tests, and the target itself uses "pruebas" that way ("casos de prueba", "pruebas controladas"). The target later switches to "marcadores de evidencia" and "evidencia" in the layers table, so the term is also inconsistent. Using «evidencia» throughout fixes both problems.

The source personifies tasks too ("Ambiguous tasks ask a clarifying question"), so this is not a meaning error. In Spanish, "Las tareas ambiguas hacen una pregunta aclaratoria" reads more like translationese than the English compression does. Naming the router is minor polish, not a required fix.

"el conjunto de fallos" means the set of all failures, which barely contrasts with "La media". The source's "failure cluster" means failures grouped by a shared trait, and the next paragraph relies on that ("Si todas las regresiones aparecen en...", "Si todos los casos fallidos usan una herramienta concreta"). That makes this a noticeable loss in a thesis sentence. «patrón de fallos» or «dónde se concentran los fallos» would fix it.

This duplicates 3ededabb, and I confirm it. The target uses "pruebas" for evidence in "análisis con muchas pruebas", "sin conservar las pruebas" and "conservación de pruebas". It uses "evidencia" in "marcadores de evidencia" and the layers table. In an eval article the key term is both ambiguous and inconsistent.

This duplicates 4e8eecf8. "Si el modelo barato falla siempre" narrows the source's "every cheap model" to a single model. That undercuts the reasoning for escalation logic over a more expensive default: with one weak model, the obvious answer is to swap it.
The gender clash is real. The target has "Los evals premian" but later "las evals dejan de parecer". This is minor and fixed together with the "uniones" rewording (see 8e9a7742).

Most of the article keeps "scorers" as the Mastra term. The live-scoring section then switches to "asociar evaluadores" and "Los evaluadores en producción", and the layers section to "configuraciones de evaluadores". The checklist goes back to "Añade scorers en producción". Readers could think a different API concept is meant. Minor terminology drift.

In the source, "philosopher-model grading ontology" reads as a noun phrase: an overbuilt grading ontology. The target's "un modelo filósofo que califique una ontología" makes "grading" a verb, so the model grades an ontology. The mockery still lands, so this is minor.
"cosida con grapas" (sewn with staples) mixes two images, while the source says simply "stapled to it". «grapada» is cleaner. Minor polish.

"no es más que intuición" is still dismissive because of "no es más que". But "intuición" is a respectable word, and the source's "vibes" is deliberately sneering. The policy asks us to keep the deliberate edge. Minor polish, not an error.

The source itself says "Useful. Also a different job.", so "también" matches the English "Also" and is not a contrast error. "Es útil. También cumple una función distinta." keeps the meaning. The shorter punch is a stylistic preference.

"No temas al enrutador de modelos" is standard Spanish for a title. The body also uses the native family ("capa de enrutamiento", "precisión de enrutamiento") next to the anglicism "router", so readers won't be confused. This is a valid alternative, not a defect.
This duplicates 392115643. "el conjunto de fallos" loses the clustering idea that the following examples depend on. I raise it to 3 to match the duplicate because it weakens the section's main claim.

This duplicates 8e9a7742. "uniones aburridas" doesn't convey testable boundaries between components. The suggested «límites aburridos entre componentes» keeps the deliberately unglamorous tone and ties into the next paragraph's explicit decision seam.

This duplicates 4e8eecf8. "el modelo barato falla siempre" swaps the source's claim across models for one model's repeated failures. Restoring «todos los modelos baratos» fixes the scope and leaves the recommendation unchanged.
This duplicates 392115643. «dónde se concentran los fallos» leads naturally into "Si todas las regresiones aparecen en...", while "el conjunto de fallos" does not.

"que el sistema sea más fácil de razonar" calques "easier to reason about". Spanish "razonar" needs "sobre" here, so this key purpose statement is ungrammatical and reads as translated. «que resulte más fácil razonar sobre el sistema» fixes it.
“Every cheap model” becomes “el modelo barato”. The source requires the failure to hold across cheap models; one model’s failure supports a different diagnosis. Use “todos los modelos baratos”.
“Boring seams” means testable boundaries, while “uniones aburridas” suggests joins. “Puntos de separación” loses the sewing image but makes the design point and dry joke intelligible.

“Production scar tissue” supports the image, but “donde vive la cicatriz de producción” sounds copied from English. “Donde se acumulan las cicatrices de producción” keeps the edge and reads naturally. This is polish, not a blocker.

In “keep the right evidence”, evidence is material retained for inspection. “Conservó las pruebas correctas” can instead mean tests in this evaluation article. “Conservó la evidencia necesaria” removes that ambiguity.
The source personifies “ambiguous tasks”, but “Las tareas ambiguas hacen una pregunta” is strained in Spanish. Naming the router as the one that asks preserves the behavior and improves the sentence.
“Failure cluster” points to failures grouped by a shared cause. “Conjunto de fallos” could mean all failures, weakening the diagnosis in the examples that follow. “Patrón de fallos” conveys it.

The source repeatedly uses “evidence”; the target alternates “pruebas” in “sin conservar las pruebas” with “evidencia” in “marcadores de evidencia”. In an article about tests, consistent “evidencia” would prevent a mistaken reading.

“If every cheap model fails” is a cross-model condition; “Si el modelo barato falla siempre” describes one model over time. I rate this above the proposed severity 3 because it changes the evidence for recommending escalation.

“Los evals premian las uniones aburridas” conflicts with the later “las evals” and obscures the testable “seams” in the source. “Las evaluaciones agradecen los puntos de separación” fixes both; “costuras” alone would retain the unclear image.

The source uses “scorers” for the same Mastra concept throughout. The target changes from “scorers” to “evaluadores” in “asociar evaluadores directamente”, which can momentarily suggest a different component. Consistent terminology would help, though the meaning remains recoverable.

“A philosopher-model grading ontology” mocks an elaborate grading scheme. “Un modelo filósofo que califique una ontología” instead makes the ontology the thing being graded. The joke survives, but its object changes.
“Ground truth stapled to it” gives a deliberately physical image. “Verdad de referencia cosida con grapas” mixes sewing and stapling; “grapada” keeps the image without the distraction.

“Vibes with a dispatch table” dismisses unmeasured routing. “Intuición con una tabla de despacho” conveys the idea but makes it sound more respectable. A sharper local expression would better preserve the deliberate jab; this remains optional polish.

“Useful. Also a different job.” is terse and contrastive. “Es útil. También cumple una función distinta.” retains both points and a short cadence; “distinta” supplies the contrast despite “también”. The suggested rewrite is a preference.

“No temas al enrutador de modelos” translates the title, while the body’s “router” is a familiar technical term. Both clearly identify the same component; the variation creates no meaningful inconsistency.

“Failure cluster” names a grouping that helps locate a cause. “Conjunto de fallos” misses that relationship. The following examples group failures by route and tool, so “dónde se agrupan los fallos” would make the transition clearer.

At the transition to testing the router separately, “seams” means boundaries that permit isolation. “Uniones aburridas” hides that point. “Límites entre componentes” loses the sewing metaphor but gains technical clarity and keeps the unglamorous tone.

The source’s “every cheap model” means the two cases defeat the cheap options as a group. The target’s “el modelo barato falla siempre” shifts to repeated failures by one model. Restoring “todos los modelos baratos” is necessary; the shift warrants severity 4 despite the proposed 3.

“Failure cluster” emphasizes where related failures concentrate. “Conjunto de fallos” does not express that pattern. “Dónde se concentran los fallos” loses the compact noun but leads naturally into the route and tool examples.

“Easier to reason about” requires reasoning about the system. “El sistema sea más fácil de razonar” omits that relation and sounds translated. “Resulta más fácil razonar sobre el sistema” preserves the central purpose.

Spanish software writing already uses "costuras" for seams (Feathers' sense), so «Las evals premian las costuras aburridas» keeps the joke and the concept without a paraphrase. Minor polish, not a meaning error; the next paragraph explains the point anyway.

Target: "«Otros» es donde vive la cicatriz de producción." Source: "where the production scar tissue lives." A single "cicatriz" that "vive" is an awkward calque; scar tissue is cumulative. «En «Otros» se acumulan las cicatrices de producción» reads native and keeps the dry image. Polish only.

Target: "conservó las pruebas correctas" for source "keep the right evidence". In an article whose subject is tests and evals, "pruebas" defaults to "tests", so the sentence reads as "kept the right tests". The same choice recurs in "sin conservar las pruebas", "conservación de pruebas" and "análisis con muchas pruebas", while later sections use "evidencia". Use "evidencia" throughout.

Target: "Las tareas ambiguas hacen una pregunta aclaratoria en lugar de adivinar." The source uses the identical personification ("Ambiguous tasks ask a clarifying question") and the list is deliberately parallel ("Las tareas arriesgadas requieren...", "Las rutas costosas requieren..."). Rewriting one item to name the router breaks that parallelism. Valid alternative, nonblocking.

Target: "La media importa menos que el conjunto de fallos." Source: "failure cluster". "Conjunto" is the whole set of failures; the following sentences ("Si todas las regresiones aparecen en...") rely on failures grouping by shared cause. «dónde se concentran los fallos» or «el patrón de fallos» carries that. Minor, since the examples make the meaning recoverable.

Same defect as 3ededabb, with the inconsistency documented: target uses "pruebas" in "conservó las pruebas correctas", "sin conservar las pruebas", "conservación de pruebas", but "evidencia" in "marcadores de evidencia ausentes" and the layers table. Source uses "evidence" for all of these. Standardize on "evidencia".

Duplicate of 4e8eecf8. Source "every cheap model" became "el modelo barato ... siempre" in target. The generalization across models is the evidence for escalation logic over a model swap. Severity 3 is the right level; not blocking-critical.

Target has "Los evals premian" and later "las evals dejan de parecer" and "el ciclo de eval". Gender flips within the same article. Pick feminine ("las evals", matching "las evaluaciones") throughout. The "uniones" half is covered under 8e9a7742.

Target uses "scorers" as the API term through most of the article, then "asociar evaluadores directamente a agentes", "Los evaluadores en producción" and "configuraciones de evaluadores a nivel de agente". Source says "scorers" in all three places, and it is the Mastra concept name ("scorers:" key in code). Keep "scorers" in those sentences.

Source: "You do not need a philosopher-model grading ontology." The hyphenated "philosopher-model" modifies "grading ontology"; the joke is about an over-elaborate grading taxonomy. Target: "un modelo filósofo que califique una ontología" makes the model grade an ontology, which is not a coherent action. «una ontología de calificación digna de un modelo filósofo» matches the source. Minor; the smoke-alarm contrast still lands.
Target: "no llega con la verdad de referencia cosida con grapas". Sewing with staples is a mixed image; source is simply "stapled to it". «grapada» alone is natural and keeps the joke. Polish.

Target: "tu router de modelos no es más que intuición con una tabla de despacho." The "no es más que" framing already carries the dismissiveness of "vibes"; "intuición" is a defensible, region-neutral choice. The originator calls it optional polish. «corazonadas» would be slightly closer, but this is a valid alternative, not a defect.

Source: "Useful. Also a different job." Target: "Es útil. También cumple una función distinta." "Also" in the source is additive too, and the contrast is carried by "distinta" in both. The terse fragment style is slightly smoothed, but meaning and attitude are preserved. Valid alternative.

Frontmatter title: "No temas al enrutador de modelos"; body throughout: "tu router de modelos", "el router", "router de modelos". A reader lands on "enrutador" and then never sees it again. Either term is fine alone; align the title with the body ("No temas al router de modelos"). Minor.

Duplicate of 39211564. "el conjunto de fallos" loses the grouping sense of "failure cluster" that the next paragraph's diagnostics depend on. The suggested «dónde se agrupan los fallos» works. Severity 2.

Duplicate of 8e9a7742. "uniones aburridas" is opaque for "boring seams". I prefer «costuras aburridas» over the proposed «límites aburridos entre componentes», because "costuras" is established software Spanish for seams and keeps the source's compactness and humor. Severity 2, not 3: the following paragraph makes the design point explicit.

Duplicate of 4e8eecf8 and 56e86301. Target "el modelo barato falla siempre" narrows source "every cheap model fails" to one model and adds temporal repetition. The suggested rewrite with «todos los modelos baratos» and «modelo predeterminado más caro» is correct and also fixes "valor predeterminado", which mistranslates "default" (a model) as a default value.

Duplicate of 39211564 and b964c40d. "conjunto de fallos" reads as all failures collectively; source "failure cluster" means failures sharing a cause. «dónde se concentran los fallos» is the most natural of the three proposals. Severity 2 because the examples immediately after clarify the intent.

Target: "El objetivo es que el sistema sea más fácil de razonar." Source: "easier to reason about". In Spanish "razonar X" means to argue or work out X, so "un sistema fácil de razonar" is a calque that native readers stumble on, and it sits in the thesis line of the section. «El objetivo es que resulte más fácil razonar sobre el sistema» is correct and neutral. Readability issue at a key point, hence 3.

Source “every cheap model” becomes “el modelo barato falla siempre”: a pattern across models becomes repeated failure by one model. This changes the condition supporting escalation. Restore “Si todos los modelos baratos fallan en los mismos dos casos ambiguos”.

“Uniones aburridas” obscures “boring seams”; the next paragraph explains testing the route before running the specialist. “Las evaluaciones agradecen los límites aburridos entre componentes” makes that separation explicit. It loses the sewing metaphor but preserves the technical point and deliberately unglamorous tone.

“Donde vive la cicatriz de producción” is understandable but awkward. “En «Otros» se acumulan las cicatrices de producción” recreates “production scar tissue” naturally and retains its dry image of accumulated experience. This is polish, not a substantial meaning error, so severity 3 overstates it.

“Conservó las pruebas correctas” can legitimately mean “keep the right evidence”; it is not inherently a mistranslation. Nevertheless, this testing article also uses “casos de prueba” and later “marcadores de evidencia”. “Conservó la evidencia pertinente” would reduce ambiguity while preserving the source’s relevance criterion.

“Las tareas ambiguas hacen una pregunta” carries over the source’s “Ambiguous tasks ask”, but the personification sounds strained here. “Ante una tarea ambigua, el router pide una aclaración en vez de adivinar” makes the implied actor explicit. It loses the compact personification and gains natural syntax without changing the behavior.

“Conjunto de fallos” does not express the shared characteristics implied by “failure cluster”. The following examples group failures by route, tool and ambiguous cases. Prefer “La media importa menos que dónde se concentran los fallos”: it loses the compact noun but restores the diagnostic emphasis.

The strongest evidence is “análisis con muchas pruebas” for “evidence-heavy analysis”: software readers may understand numerous tests rather than substantial supporting evidence. “Pruebas” is otherwise legitimate, so not every occurrence is wrong. Consistent “evidencia”, already present in “marcadores de evidencia”, would remove this recurring ambiguity.

“Every cheap model” and “el modelo barato” have different scope, changing the evidence for escalation. This merits severity 4 rather than 3. However, the peer’s claim that the cases are “inherently hard” goes beyond the source; the supported claim is simply that the failures recur across all cheap models.

The target alternates “Los evals premian” with “las evals dejan de parecer”. Consistent “las evaluaciones” would remove the gender drift. The proposed “costuras aburridas” still leaves the technical metaphor obscure; the separate severity-3 seam issues justify explicitly naming component boundaries.

“Una evaluación necesita ejemplos y scorers” later becomes “asociar evaluadores directamente”. Both translate the source’s “scorers”, and context makes their identity recoverable, so this is minor terminology drift. Retaining “scorers” or explicitly introducing “scorers (evaluadores)” would make that identity clearer.

The compressed source “a philosopher-model grading ontology” most naturally makes “ontology” the grading framework. “Un modelo filósofo que califique una ontología” instead makes it the object being graded. “Una ontología de evaluación digna de un modelo filósofo” restores that relationship, though the source’s awkward compression limits the seriousness of the defect.

“La verdad de referencia cosida con grapas” adds an unnecessary sewing action to “ground truth stapled to it”. “La verdad de referencia grapada” preserves the deliberately physical joke and reads more cleanly. The current meaning remains clear, so this is minor polish.

“No es más que intuición con una tabla de despacho” retains the dismissal through “no es más que” and the absurd technical pairing. Although “intuición” alone is more respectable than “vibes”, the whole sentence preserves the attack on unmeasured routing. “Puras sensaciones” is an optional alternative, not a necessary repair.

The source itself says “Useful. Also a different job.” The target’s “Es útil. También cumple una función distinta” preserves both the additive wording and the distinction through “distinta”. “Útil. Pero es otro trabajo” is punchier, but the existing two short sentences remain credible and faithful.

“No temas al enrutador de modelos” and the body’s “router de modelos” transparently name the same thing. A Spanish title followed by familiar developer terminology does not create a technical distinction or impede comprehension. Aligning them is a valid preference, not a demonstrated defect.

“Conjunto de fallos” weakens “failure cluster” at the transition into examples of failures sharing a route or tool. That diagnostic connection makes this more than severity-2 polish. “La media importa menos que dónde se agrupan los fallos” restores the grouping while replacing the compact noun with natural Spanish.

“Uniones aburridas” does not clearly convey the testable boundaries in “boring seams”. The nearby “probar la ruta antes de que se ejecute el especialista” supports “límites aburridos entre componentes”. This adaptation sacrifices the sewing image but gains technical clarity and retains the joke about deliberately mundane design.

The contrast between “every cheap model” and “el modelo barato falla siempre” establishes both a lost universal condition and an added temporal one. This materially changes the escalation argument, warranting severity 4. “Todos los modelos baratos fallan” restores the source; “modelo predeterminado” also makes the implied default clearer.

“Failure cluster” concerns concentration among related cases, whereas “conjunto de fallos” can mean the entire collection. The following “una herramienta concreta” example confirms the grouping matters. “Dónde se concentran los fallos” preserves that diagnostic purpose, losing only the compact cluster label and gaining a clearer transition.

“El sistema sea más fácil de razonar” treats the system as the direct object of reasoning, awkwardly reproducing “easier to reason about”. “El objetivo es que resulte más fácil razonar sobre el sistema” restores the Spanish relationship and preserves the central statement’s meaning without adding or removing claims.

The target still says «“Otros” es donde vive la cicatriz de producción». In Spanish, the singular «cicatriz» reads like one specific wound. The source's "production scar tissue" means damage that has built up over time. A plural form such as «se acumulan las cicatrices de producción» keeps the dry image and sounds natural. This is polish, not a blocker.

The target still has «la verdad de referencia cosida con grapas». «Coser» (to sew) and «grapas» (staples) are two different ways of attaching something, so the joke gets muddy. The source only says "stapled to it". «pegada con grapas» or «grapada» keeps the absurd image and reads more cleanly. The meaning is intact, so this is minor.

This article is about testing, and it already uses «pruebas» to mean tests («casos de prueba», «conjunto de pruebas pequeño»). The target also uses «pruebas» for "evidence" in «conservó las pruebas correctas», «sin conservar las pruebas», «conservación de pruebas» and «análisis con muchas pruebas». The last one can easily be read as "analysis with many tests". Later, the target switches to «marcadores de evidencia» and «límites de rechazo, evidencia», so the term is inconsistent. This is a noticeable readability issue. Using «evidencia» throughout would fix it.

Most of the article keeps «scorers» as the Mastra term («Una evaluación necesita ejemplos y scorers», «Escribe scorers deterministas», «Añade scorers en producción»). The live-scoring section switches to «asociar evaluadores», «Los evaluadores en producción» and «configuraciones de evaluadores». This makes it harder for readers to connect the prose to the `scorers` API key. It is a consistency fix, not a meaning error.

The target calls the same metric «precisión de la ruta» in the axes table and the scorer section. It calls it «precisión de enrutamiento» in the experiment bullets and in the heading «Qué medir después de la precisión de enrutamiento». The source always says "route accuracy". One term should be used throughout, and «precisión de ruta» matches the `route-accuracy` id. This is minor.

«Los evals premian las uniones aburridas» uses the generic word «uniones» for "seams". In software testing, "seams" are usually rendered as «costuras», so the reference is lost. The target also uses two genders for the same noun: «Los evals» here, but «las evals dejan de parecer» later. Both are small fixes, and neither blocks the translation.

This duplicates 26e56f11ace60436c3a2. «cosida con grapas» mixes sewing with stapling, while the source only says "stapled to it". «grapada» or «pegada con grapas» is cleaner. The joke still works, so this is minor polish.

«el conjunto de fallos» only means "the set of failures". The source's "failure cluster" means that failures bunch up in one place. The next paragraph depends on that idea («Si todas las regresiones aparecen en la síntesis de políticas…»). «dónde se concentran los fallos» or «el patrón de fallos» restores the point. The argument can still be followed, so this is minor.

The source says "If every cheap model fails the same two ambiguous cases", which describes a pattern across several models. The target's «Si el modelo barato falla siempre en los mismos dos casos ambiguos» describes one model failing again and again. If only one cheap model fails, trying another cheap model is still an option. The case for escalation logic rests on every cheap model failing. The meaning change is noticeable, so I rate it 3, not 2. The conclusion is still preserved and no code or numbers are affected, so it is not 4.

«¡Combate los males con evaluaciones!» is a valid, readable title for a linked post, and the URL `/llm-evals-are-broken` is preserved exactly. The Evils/Evals pun can't be carried over literally. The packet has no checked reference showing the linked post's Spanish title, so asking for a match with it is unsupported. Using «evals» is only an optional preference.

«no es más que intuición con una tabla de despacho» keeps the dismissive point of "vibes with a dispatch table", and «no es más que» supplies the edge. The suggested «buenas vibras» or «puro feeling» are more regionally marked, which works against the goal of being readable in all regions. This is a valid alternative, not a defect.

This is the same defect as 819fc9fb589bbccfc198: "every cheap model" became «el modelo barato». I agree it needs fixing, but not at severity 4. The recommendation still follows logically («necesitas lógica de escalado, no un valor predeterminado más caro»), and no code, quantities or identifiers are affected. That makes it a noticeable meaning change (3), not a high-priority error. The fix is to write «Si todos los modelos baratos fallan en los mismos dos casos ambiguos».

The blanket claim that "several English images were copied too closely" doesn't hold up. The target recreates many images well: «una alarma de humo con la pila puesta», «Los promedios son el lugar al que van a jubilarse los fallos útiles», «convierta tu base de código en un santuario», «un panel que hace que todo el mundo se sienta adulto temporalmente». The weak spots («uniones aburridas», «cicatriz», «cosida con grapas») are already tracked as separate issues at severity 2. Grouping them does not make them a severity-4 blocker.

Dan's voice comes through across the target: «Sí, esto es un poco artificial. Bien.», «Ese scorer no tiene glamour. Ese es el objetivo.», «Eso sí es una conversación de ingeniería», «Evalúa la decisión. Evalúa el camino. Evalúa la respuesta.» The quoted example, «no es más que intuición con una tabla de despacho», keeps the dismissive barb. The source contains no profanity that could have been sanitized away. At most, a few lines could be sharper, which is polish and not a severity-4 voice failure.

This duplicates d4fad9b833800e74227e. The same three images are already tracked individually at severity 2: «uniones aburridas» (45cdb7f9949fc0b5ccd1), «cicatriz de producción» (ebda69736e18c485a943) and «cosida con grapas» (26e56f11ace60436c3a2). Each one is understandable, and none changes the meaning. The rest of the target's jokes work, and this issue itself says as much. The individual fixes should go ahead, but this is not a blocking severity-4 idiom failure.

The source’s “production scar tissue” suggests accumulated experience. «Donde vive la cicatriz de producción» preserves the image but sounds strained in Spanish; plural «cicatrices» would read more naturally.
«Cosida con grapas» mixes sewing and stapling. The source’s “stapled to it” needs only the staple image; «grapada» would keep the joke sharper.

The source distinguishes “evidence” from test cases. The candidate uses «pruebas» for evidence in «conservó las pruebas correctas» and «casos de prueba» for tests, then switches to «marcadores de evidencia». Using «evidencia» consistently would remove the ambiguity.

The candidate introduces the Mastra term as «scorers» but later says «asociar evaluadores» and «configuraciones de evaluadores». That switch makes the prose less consistent with the source’s API term “scorers.”
The same source metric, “route accuracy,” appears as «precisión de la ruta» and «precisión de enrutamiento». Both are intelligible, but one name throughout would make the metric easier to follow.

«Los evals premian las uniones aburridas» is awkward for the source’s compact engineering image, “Evals reward boring seams”; the candidate also later says «las evals». This merits a local wording and agreement fix, though the peer’s claim of a mandatory conventional translation is not established by the packet.

The target’s «cosida con grapas» is an awkward rendering of “stapled to it.” «Grapada» would preserve the physical image. This is the same local defect as issue 26e56f11ace60436c3a2, not a separate escalation.

“Failure cluster” points to where failures concentrate; «conjunto de fallos» only denotes a set. The next paragraph groups regressions by route, tool and model, so «patrón de fallos» would better set it up.

The source says “every cheap model fails the same two ambiguous cases,” while the target says «el modelo barato falla siempre». That changes the diagnostic from failure across models to repeated failure of one model, weakening the stated basis for escalation logic. The quantifier needs restoring.

«¡Combate los males con evaluaciones!» loses the source’s “Evils/Evals” sound play, but communicates the linked title’s purpose. The packet does not establish the linked post’s Spanish title, so alignment with it cannot be required; a new pun is optional.
«Intuición con una tabla de despacho» recreates “vibes with a dispatch table” as a pointed technical insult. «Buenas vibras» would be a voice preference, not a demonstrated defect.

The opposing severity 2 assessment understates the scope change: “every cheap model” means the failure persists across cheap models, whereas «el modelo barato» identifies one. The closing recommendation relies on that distinction. This duplicates issue 819fc9fb589bbccfc198.

There is evidence of several local misses: “boring seams” becomes «uniones aburridas», and “failure cluster” becomes «conjunto de fallos». The broader severity 4 assessment overstates their impact: the argument remains readable, and these images can be repaired locally.

The cited «intuición con una tabla de despacho» retains the dry jab in “vibes with a dispatch table”; «santuario» and «alarma de humo con la pila puesta» also carry the source’s edge. The packet supports individual phrasing fixes, not a blocking loss of authorial voice.

The examples substantiate polish work: «uniones aburridas», «la cicatriz de producción» and «cosida con grapas» are less natural than the source images’ purpose calls for. They are local metaphor problems, so the peer’s severity 4 is too high; none obscures the article’s main technical argument.

«Donde vive la cicatriz de producción» resulta rígido frente a «production scar tissue», que evoca experiencia acumulada. Propongo «En “Otros” se acumulan las cicatrices de producción»: cambia tejido por cicatrices, conserva la imagen del daño y mejora la naturalidad. Es un ajuste menor, no un bloqueo.

«Cosida con grapas» hace más aparatosa la imagen de «ground truth stapled to it». Aunque se entiende, «no llega con la verdad de referencia grapada» conserva el chiste físico con mayor concisión. Prefiero esa opción a «pegada con grapas», que tampoco simplifica del todo la expresión.

«Pruebas» puede significar legítimamente evidencia; no es una traducción incorrecta por sí sola. Sin embargo, «análisis con muchas pruebas» resulta ambiguo en un artículo con «casos de prueba», y el propio texto emplea «marcadores de evidencia». Usar «evidencia» para el material que sustenta conclusiones distinguiría mejor ese concepto de los tests.

El cambio de «Una evaluación necesita ejemplos y scorers» a «asociar evaluadores directamente» introduce una variación innecesaria para el mismo componente que el original llama «scorers». «Evaluadores» es correcto y el código permite reconocerlo, por lo que no hay daño técnico; mantener «scorers» facilitaría seguir el concepto.

«Precisión de la ruta» y «precisión de enrutamiento» identifican aquí la misma métrica de «route accuracy», sin sugerir cálculos distintos. Uniformarlas sería una preferencia editorial, no una corrección necesaria. La semejanza con el identificador «route-accuracy» tampoco obliga a preferir la formulación más corta.

«Los evals premian las uniones aburridas» vuelve poco reconocible la idea de «boring seams»: separar componentes para poder probarlos. El paquete no acredita la atribución a Feathers ni una traducción convencional obligatoria como «costuras». Propongo «Las evals agradecen puntos de separación simples y claros»: pierde la imagen textil, pero recupera el sentido técnico y mantiene una personificación discreta. Además, concuerda con «las evals» usado después.

«No llega con la verdad de referencia cosida con grapas» conserva el significado de «stapled to it», pero entorpece el remate. Como en la otra observación sobre esta frase, prefiero «no llega con la verdad de referencia grapada». «Adjunta» sería claro, aunque perdería innecesariamente la imagen humorística.

«El conjunto de fallos» no expresa tan claramente la concentración que aporta «the failure cluster». El párrafo siguiente, «Si todas las regresiones aparecen en…», recupera la idea y limita el impacto. «La media importa menos que dónde se concentran los fallos» sacrifica la formulación nominal y gana precisión sin añadir información.

«Every cheap model fails the same two ambiguous cases» pasa a «el modelo barato falla siempre», cambiando una condición sobre todos los modelos por otra sobre fallos repetidos de uno. Discrepo de que la conclusión siga sustentada igual: el segundo supuesto deja abierta la posibilidad de resolverlo con otro modelo barato. Debe decir «Si todos los modelos baratos fallan en los mismos dos casos ambiguos».

«¡Combate los males con evaluaciones!» conserva el mandato juguetón de «Fight Evils with Evals!», aunque pierde la semejanza sonora. «Males con evals» tampoco recrea ese juego de forma clara. El paquete no incluye el título español del artículo enlazado, por lo que no permite afirmar una discrepancia con él.

«No es más que intuición con una tabla de despacho» conserva la burla de «vibes with a dispatch table»: una decisión sin medición revestida de mecanismo técnico. Pierde parte del registro coloquial inglés, pero gana claridad entre regiones. «Buenas vibras» añade una connotación positiva ausente y «feeling» no demuestra una mejora de voz.

La comparación directa confirma el cambio: «every cheap model» significa todos los modelos baratos, mientras «el modelo barato falla siempre» describe uno solo repetidamente. Coincido con la objeción por esa alteración de la condición que justifica el escalado, no por acuerdo entre revisores. Restituir «todos los modelos baratos» repara el argumento.

«Uniones aburridas» comunica peor que «boring seams» la separación que permite probar la decisión por sí misma. Requiere una adaptación más clara, pero la frase siguiente, «puedes probar la ruta antes de que se ejecute el especialista», explica el mecanismo. Por ello sostengo el defecto localizado y rechazo elevarlo a gravedad 4 o extenderlo sin más a todas las metáforas.

El fragmento citado, «no es más que intuición con una tabla de despacho», mantiene el golpe despectivo de «vibes with a dispatch table». También sobreviven remates como «Los promedios son el lugar al que van a jubilarse los fallos útiles». Hay tropiezos puntuales recogidos en otros votos, pero esta evidencia no sostiene un fallo grave de voz ni exige cambiar una adaptación válida.

«Uniones aburridas», «la cicatriz de producción» y «cosida con grapas» sí justifican revisar estas imágenes de «boring seams», «production scar tissue» y «stapled to it». La primera oscurece una idea técnica; las otras dos son asperezas menores. El contexto conserva el argumento y los chistes siguen siendo reconocibles, así que no respaldo gravedad 4. Legibilidad global: 4/5, con estos problemas pendientes visibles.

Target: «Otros» es donde vive la cicatriz de producción. Source: "Other" is where the production scar tissue lives. The singular 'la cicatriz' reads as one specific wound rather than accumulated damage, and 'vive' attached to a singular scar is a calque. Plural 'las cicatrices de producción' or 'el tejido cicatricial' restores the accumulated-experience image. Minor polish; the meaning is still recoverable.

Target: 'no llega con la verdad de referencia cosida con grapas'. Source: 'stapled to it'. Stapling is one action; 'cosida con grapas' invents a second mechanism (sewing) that Spanish does not need. 'grapada encima' or 'pegada con grapas' keeps the absurd physical joke and is crisper. Same defect as 4d459636ae4629c69e82; fix once.

Target renders 'evidence' as 'pruebas' in 'conservó las pruebas correctas', 'sin conservar las pruebas', 'conservación de pruebas' and 'análisis con muchas pruebas', but uses 'evidencia' in 'marcadores de evidencia', 'límites de rechazo, evidencia' and 'discutir desde la evidencia'. In a post whose vocabulary is 'casos de prueba' and 'conjunto de pruebas', 'análisis con muchas pruebas' (source: 'evidence-heavy analysis') reads as 'analysis with many tests', which is a genuine misreading for the target audience. Use 'evidencia' consistently for the security/observability sense.

Target keeps 'scorers' as a technical term ('Una evaluación necesita ejemplos y scorers', 'Escribe scorers deterministas', 'Añade scorers en producción') but switches to 'evaluadores' in 'asociar evaluadores directamente a agentes', 'Los evaluadores en producción' and '`runEvals` admite configuraciones de evaluadores'. Source uses 'scorers' in all these places. A reader mapping prose to the `scorers` config key loses the thread. Consistency fix, not a meaning error.

Target uses 'precisión de la ruta' in the axes table and in 'La precisión de la ruta no necesita un modelo juez', then 'precisión de enrutamiento' in the experiment bullets, the heading 'Qué medir después de la precisión de enrutamiento' and 'La precisión de enrutamiento es el primer peldaño'. Source uses 'route accuracy' for all of them and it matches the scorer id 'route-accuracy'. One metric should carry one name.
